subject: rt-dym
title: RT.DYM.------CULT.INFO.B.
description: Diagram in WAM-14, the page where Braxton names 'intellectual empiricism' as the dominant force shaping western culture's progressional continuance after the dissolution of its composite spiritual center. RT-DY (reality dynamics) is crossed with CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis): the diagram poses that the *basis* on which a culture processes information determines what its reality dynamics will look like. The chain runs: RT-DY → CULT-INFO-B branches into AFTD (affinity tendencies), MT-INFO (music information), and SOC-RT (social reality). SOC-RT then branches into PRI-INFO (primary information) and IST-F (isolated focus); IST-F closes via a *dashed* edge to (r)INTR (the reality of interpretation), marking that the link from isolated focus to interpretive practice is conditional rather than guaranteed. The structural argument: when culture-information basis is empirical-intellectual rather than spiritual-composite, reality dynamics no longer flow whole — they fragment into separated streams of tendency, music-information, and social reality, with isolated focus only contingently producing interpretation.
